values.note: Sites reserve site-specific on Kansas's ReserveAmerica site (campitks.gov); unreserved sites allow self-registration on arrival. Stays between October and March can be reserved only by calling the park office (8 a.m.-4 p.m. Monday-Friday). 2027 holiday minimum: 3 nights over Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends. Up to 14 consecutive nights in one campground, then move to another campground in the park.

note: Big KDWP park on the north shore of Clinton Reservoir near Lawrence, in two campgrounds about 1.9 km apart on the bluff: Prairie Clover (pinned; the full-hookup sites and cabins) and Coneflower to the west, each with a ~100-150 m wooded strip between its pads and the shoreline. --Claude
summary: Confirmed not waterfront, hookups 50/water/sewer; sites 369 from campitks (pull-throughs at Coneflower); year-round; booking in the 2095 shape with the Oct-Mar phone-only reservations; split candidate Prairie Clover / Coneflower.
flags: WATERFRONT: NOT WATERFRONT kept. Prairie Clover's south row (086-107) sits ~100 m above the shoreline behind a continuous wooded strip; Coneflower's nearest sites (413-427) are ~100-150 m back through woods (Esri imagery 2026-11-06 with campitks coordinates). Not upgraded to lakeview: woods between every pad and the water (KDWP says the cabins have lake views from their porches; cabins are not counted).

SPLIT CANDIDATE (don't split; for AWH): Prairie Clover and Coneflower are separate campgrounds ~1.9 km apart. Utility-site centroids: Prairie Clover 38.93094,-95.36278 (86 utility sites: 34 full hookup 50 A, 52 water/electric; 65 primitive; 7 cabins; all back-in, lengths 20-70 ft); Coneflower 38.93671,-95.38315 (119 water/electric, 29 of them 50 A, 91 at 30 A; 99 primitive; no sewer; 58 pull-through; lengths 24-80 ft). Each sits at the end of its own spur off the park road (Coneflower to the northwest, Prairie Clover to the southeast of the central junction); they appear to share the park's main entrance. Neither is waterfront. Both have shower houses (campitks per-site details).
